profile.headline: Software Developer.  Passionate about Learning, Hospitality and Costumer Service Training.
profile.summary: A professional Full Stack Engineer focus on front-end development with experience in Javascript,  React, HTML and CSS. Experience in business management in the fast food and casual restaurant sector, customer service and staff training. As a training coordinator I facilitated different courses such as induction to new staff, training and certification of coaches, shift management in a restaurant, transition to leader and accountability besides monitoring and evaluation of training and knowledge of upcoming managers in new restaurants.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
- Manage all team members on shift (FOH and BOH).
- Closely monitor food quality and staff interactions with guests, proactively addressing issues to ensure costumers receive a positive experience.
- Manage and Inventory and purchase dining and kitchen supplies. Track food cost and stat reports.
- Ensure Team Members understand, follow and complied with company procedures.

positions.title: Training Coornidator,
positions.description:
I worked as a restaurant manager and  training coordinator for Chili's restaurants.

During my stay at Chili’s I provided training to staff members destined to occupy future positions at new openings, counting up to 65 stores.
 
Gave follow up to previous training work with subsequent visits to units within a vast territory.
 
Evaluated the operational knowledge of managers at work or those in the process to assume a new position.
 
Implemented protocols of training established and audited by Brinker International or Alsea company concerning the opening of new stores.
 
Directly involved in the training of middle managerial positions as well as those with direct customer contact.
 


Trabajé como Gerente de restaurante y Coordinador de entrenamiento para los restaurante Chili´s.

Actividades de mi ultimo puesto:
* Facilitar cursos de entrenamiento al staff en mas de 60 restaurantes operados por Alsea en ciudad de México. 
* Entrenar y certificar a nuevos entrenadores en cada restaurante.
* Evaluar el seguimiento de entrenamiento en cada unidad.
* Evaluar conocimientos de los gerentes que se encontraban en proceso de entrenamiento.
* Realizar agendas de entrenamiento para actividades de apertura en nuevos restaurantes.
* Dirigir actividades de entrenamiento en apertura de nuevos restaurantes.
